text:
marta: quick check — we're turning on ephemeral trace capture for a small canary (staging -> prod rollout). the trace will include request headers and a tiny prompt snippet for debugging. curious what to do with header fields like `X-Customer-Email` and `Authorization` — should we redact, hash, or keep? plan is 48h TTL and access only for SRE oncall + dev on request. example header: ``curl -H \"X-Customer-Email: user@example.com\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer abcdef12345\" https://api.redwood.internal/serve``

sam: definitely never log raw `Authorization` (tokens). for headers with emails i prefer pseudonymize rather than full redact so we can correlate sessions without exposing PII. HMAC(email, per-customer-salt) stored in secure store. must be reversible only by sec with ticket? if reversible needed, we need a ticketing workflow. otherwise one-way hash ok for dedup. :eyes:

eli: agree with sam on auth. additional notes from sec side:
- in prod: redact `Authorization` completely and do not keep any reversible form.
- for emails in headers/prompts: two safe options — full redact (`<EMAIL_REDACTED>`) or truncated SHA256 (first 16 chars) with salt kept in KMS. truncated hash acceptable for correlation but requires documented KMS access policy and rotation cadence.
- any exception (reversible mapping, storing plaintext) requires a JIRA and approval by Security and Privacy.

marta: got it. one more Q: what about prompt snippets? some prompts include user-supplied text like "contact john.doe@example.com" — should we run the same mask on prompt text before storing sample traces? we need a minimal footprint to preserve error repro but remove PII.

sam: yep run mask on prompt pipeline. simple regex replace is ok for common cases, e.g.:
````
# pipeline pseudo-config
regex: "[\\w.%-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.\\w+"
replace: "<EMAIL_REDACTED>"
````
This lets us still see rest of the prompt for repro while removing emails. leave short prefixes intact for caching (don't strip the whole prompt).

marta: example of expected stored prompt after masking: `Create an invite for <EMAIL_REDACTED> to the project` — good?

eli: that's fine. add these operational checks:
- staging: allowed to store truncated hash instead of redact for debugging, but access must be logged and time-limited.
- prod: default to `<EMAIL_REDACTED>` only.
- retention: 48h TTL as you suggested; sec wants a 7-day audit log for who accessed traces (not the traces themselves).

log-collector-bot: deployed masking rule to staging pipeline (regex-email -> <EMAIL_REDACTED>) at 2472003600. only header keys in `mask-list` are masked; `Authorization` removed entirely.

marta: thanks all — i'll open the JIRA for prod rollout with the KMS access doc + retention details. tagging @sam to help with pipeline PR. :thumbsup:

eli: please include a short test plan (samples showing masking) in the PR. once that's attached sec will do the approvals review. :white_check_mark:
